text:
liang: heads-up: onboarding Nimbus-v2-q5 into dedicated canary. Multilang suite flagged a nasty regression for zh+he legal docs. Brackets and bidi markers are being reordered in outputs.

anya: do you have a minimal repro? any raw tokens or detokenized example?

liang: minimal repro below (detok shown):
```
SRC: 当事人同意第3条 (סעיף 3) 根据本协议承担责任。
EXPECTED: 当事人同意第3条 (סעיף 3) 根据本协议承担责任。
Q5_OUT: 当事人同意第3条 )סעיף 3( 根据本协议承担责任。
```
Note: parentheses swapped around the Hebrew phrase and the LTR punctuation ended up on the wrong side.

mikko: metrics from eval run? how bad is it?

evalbot: summary: legal-zh-he BLEU fell 7.1 -> 2.8, detok-preserve-brackets 99% -> 57%, bidi-vis-order errors 0.6% -> 18.4%. Regression correlates with q5 kernel switch at 2026-03-18T03:14Z.

anya: could this be a tokenizer merge that makes the decoder see different token boundaries and the bidi pass misapplies mirror rules?

mikko: I don't think tokenization explains bracket flip — that's a decode/postprocess/visual-order issue. Maybe the mirroring table was quantized and sign flipped during int8 scale fitting. Check the LUT dtype and rounding behavior in quant pipeline.

liang: I'll run a controlled repro capturing token ids, raw logits, and post-process steps. repro command: `./scripts/repro.sh --model nimbus-v2 --quant q5 --locale zh_he --samples 64 --dump=all`

oscar: temporary mitigation: routing-bot, can we force locale-route for legal-zh-he to use nimbus-v2:fp16 for now? Want to avoid surfacing to customers.

routing-bot: ack. Proposed rule: match (model_family:nimbus-v2, locale:legal-zh-he) -> prefer variant:fp16. Planned rollout: canary 5% -> 100% in 30m unless rollback.

anya: also add a tiny synthetic case to the preflight suite with mixed CJK + RTL and punctuation combos so CI catches this earlier. I'll open a small PR with test vectors.

mikko: for bisect, try: (1) q5 quant table: original vs re-fit symmetric int8; (2) kernel set: old-matmul vs fused-matmul; (3) decode path: original bidi mirror apply vs skip-mirror. Run permutations on a 16-sample subset.

liang: running bisect now. uploading logs to the eval run (link). Will post key diffs — if mirror LUT casts are the trigger we can keep that table fp32 or special-case it in the quantizer.

oscar: thanks. please include an example where an embedded Hebrew ordinal like "סעיף 3" is wrapped by different punctuation types (（）[]). That helped QA catch it.

liang: will do. updating thread with results in ~45m.
